awards.title: BetterWeb – Chrome Extension (GenAI Genesis 2025 Finalist, Accessibility Track)
awards.description: BetterWeb is aimed at enhancing online accessibility using Generative AI. Created during GenAI Genesis 2025 at U of T—our team was recognized as a top contender in the Accessibility Track among 600+ participants. Sponsored by Google, AMD, and others, the event focused on solutions aligned with the UN’s Sustainable Development Goals.

posts.text: Excited to share that I've joined Community-Based Research Canada (CBRCanada) as a Web Development Intern for the summer of 2025! I'll be working on revamping and improving the accessibility, design, and user experience of their website — a challenge I'm genuinely excited about. Huge thanks to Johnny Kung and Joanna Ochocka for the opportunity and warm welcome. Looking forward to contributing to an organization doing meaningful work across Canada and beyond! #WebDevelopment #Internship #Communit
